content.text:
The Send message button on the contact page now spans the full width of the form fields. I added a rule in `site/css/components.css` that targets `#contact-form .btn` and sets `display: flex; width: 100%`. I scoped it to the contact form because the shared `.form .btn` rule also styles the newsletter button on the home page, and that one should stay the same.

I ran the visual tests. Only `contact__desktop` and `contact__phone` changed (about 1.8% and 2.0% of pixels), and both changes are on that button. The other 10 snapshots are unchanged. I didn't run the functional tests, and I haven't looked at the diff images.

I haven't approved the new baselines, because that needs your review. To approve them, run `npx testivai approve contact__desktop contact__phone`, or tell me to.

STATUS: DONE
